title: Pilot for Online Version of Application for a U.S. Passport (Form DS-11)
summary: State Department — Notice — The Department of State is announcing a pilot program to accept certain renewal and first-time passport applications online. Interested applicants will be able to visit America.gov to check their eligibility to submit a passport application through this pilot. It is anticipated that the pool of eligible applicants will be expanded as testing progresses.
